item.title: The Jamison Family Vanished With $32,000 Left Behind
item.description: The Jamison family disappeared in rural Oklahoma in 2009, leaving their dog, phones and $32,000 in their truck. Hunters found the couple’s and their six-year-old daughter’s remains four years later, but autopsies could not determine how they died.

item.title: Amie Harwick’s Ex Waited Hours Inside Her Home
item.description: Los Angeles therapist Amie Harwick, 38, was killed in February 2020 after her ex-boyfriend broke into her home and waited for her return. Gareth Pursehouse was convicted of first-degree murder and burglary in 2023 and sentenced to life without parole.

item.title: Tabitha Tuders Left For School But Never Boarded The Bus
item.description: Thirteen-year-old Tabitha Tuders disappeared while walking to her school bus stop in Nashville on April 29, 2003. Police reported a red car near where she was last seen. She never arrived at school, and her disappearance remains unsolved.

item.title: John Couey Hid Jessica Lunsford Across The Street
item.description: Nine-year-old Jessica Lunsford disappeared from her Homosassa, Florida, home in 2005. Her fingerprints and DNA were found in John Couey’s nearby trailer. Convicted of her kidnapping and murder in 2007, he was sentenced to death and died in custody in 2009.

item.title: Evelyn Boswell Was Found In Her Mother’s Old Playhouse
item.description: Tennessee toddler Evelyn Boswell was reported missing in February 2020, months after she was last seen. Investigators found her remains in her mother’s childhood playhouse. Megan Boswell was convicted of murder in 2025 and sentenced to life plus 33 years.
